risk_if_not_implemented: Without Deferred Patching Decisions, known and exploitable vulnerabilities may remain unaddressed, giving adversaries readily available entry points. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Exposure from Unaddressed Vulnerabilities (R-EX-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Dysfunctional Management Practices (MT-8), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Software & Firmware Patching
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to conduct software patching for all deployed Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS), including firmware.
compensating_control_1.justification: Software & Firmware Patching (VPM-08) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Deferred Patching Decisions (VPM-09) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Continuous Vulnerability Remediation Activities
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to address new threats and vulnerabilities on an ongoing basis and ensure assets are protected against known attacks.
compensating_control_2.justification: Continuous Vulnerability Remediation Activities (VPM-06.2) provides vulnerability management that compensates for the absence of Deferred Patching Decisions (VPM-09) by reducing the exploitable attack surface by addressing known weaknesses before they are leveraged. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
